label: 1. I'm Helm, the leader of the Aegis Squad, as we…

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I'm Helm, the leader of the Aegis Squad, as well as the captain of the Admire.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: It's an honor to fight together with you.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I'm looking forward to it.
Sum here.
Same here.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Oh, a typo.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I thought you may have meant something else.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I don't use Blabla much,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: so I'm not up to date on all the newest lingo.
You'll get better at it if you chat with me more.
No worries, you've got bigger fish to fry.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I appreciate it,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: but I already have a lot on my plate.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: There are more important things in life.
For example?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Are you asking because you're actually curious?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Or are you just messing with me?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Sorry,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I guess you really don't know what we do at Aegis.
You operate a massive ship, don't you?
You're essentially the navy, right?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: However...

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Hmm... I'm a little reluctant to say this.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: It's nothing embarrassing, but it's not exactly something to be proud of.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: If you have time, you're more than welcome to attend our next boat party.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Then you'll see what Aegis is all about.
I'll definitely be there if I get the chance.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Sounds good.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Talk to you later.
